name: Draw & Guess
hook: One player draws. Everyone else guesses.
how: Take turns drawing a secret word in 60 seconds. Everyone else types guesses, and faster right guesses score more. Letters show up as time runs out.
controls: Mouse or finger to draw, type to guess
uses: The word is sealed so only the drawer can read it (the host picks it, so it can too).
The host's browser picks the drawer and the word, checks guesses and keeps score; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots draw simple doodles and guess, sometimes right.
Each player's best game, in points.
ideas: Add a word pack about movies
Let players vote on the best drawing
